ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What does the sparrow feed on?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram is titled Urban Food Web. It shows several animals and insects connected by food-web arrows. Near the lower middle of the diagram, the small bird identified as the sparrow is connected with an arrow coming from the fly/insect below it toward the bird. Reasoning: In this food web, the item at the tail/source of the arrow is the food being eaten, and the arrow points to the consumer. Since the arrow goes from the fly to the sparrow, the sparrow feeds on a fly.
